body.statement: Using \(\mathcal H_{\mathrm{adapt}}\), can one construct a fully data-dependent studentized face-retention rule whose common-multiplier confidence interval preserves the uniform whole-set coverage conclusion of \(\texttt{thm:uniform-face-envelope}\) over \(\mathcal P\) and remains first-order equivalent to the oracle face envelope under \(\texttt{ass:oracle-separation}\), without requiring the analyst to specify a deterministic sequence \(a_n\)?
body.justification: Automatic studentized retention would remove the only deterministic tuning sequence from the otherwise explicit finite-face procedure.
body.gap: Andrews and Barwick calibrate automatic moment selection for moment inequalities, but do not cover the linked projection, numerator-cut, survivor-minimum, and denominator faces of this quotient map.
body.consumer: A Job Corps analysis could use a reproducible default calibration while retaining protection against changing wage-cut and survivor-support faces.
